rules.name: Brute Force — Rapid Failed Logins from Single Source
rules.description: Detects rapid sequential failed login attempts from a single IP address exceeding threshold within time window, indicating brute force attack
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.outcome:"failure"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Brute Force — Distributed Failed Logins from Multiple IPs
rules.description: Detects distributed brute force attacks where multiple source IPs target a single account, indicating coordinated credential guessing
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.outcome:"failure"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Brute Force — Password Spray Attack
rules.description: Detects password spray attacks where a single IP attempts login with common passwords across many accounts
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.outcome:"failure"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Brute Force — SSH Brute Force Attack
rules.description: Detects SSH brute force attacks characterized by rapid failed authentication attempts on SSH service
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND service.name:"ssh" AND event.outcome:"failure" AND source.ip:* AND user.name:*
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Brute Force — RDP Brute Force Attack
rules.description: Detects RDP brute force attacks with rapid failed logins on Terminal Services
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND (service.name:"rdp" OR service.name:"terminal-services" OR event.action:"rdp-login") AND event.outcome:"failure"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Brute Force — VPN Credential Stuffing
rules.description: Detects credential stuffing attacks against VPN concentrators with high failure rates from diverse IPs
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND (service.name:"vpn" OR event.action:"vpn-login") AND event.outcome:"failure" AND source.geo.country_name:*
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Brute Force — HTTP Basic Auth Brute Force
rules.description: Detects brute force attacks against HTTP Basic Authentication with rapid 401 responses from single source
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.outcome:"failure" AND http.response.status_code:401
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Brute Force — LDAP Bind Brute Force
rules.description: Detects brute force attacks against LDAP authentication with repeated bind failures
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND (service.name:"ldap" OR event.action:"ldap-bind") AND event.outcome:"failure"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Brute Force — FTP Login Brute Force
rules.description: Detects brute force attacks on FTP services with repeated authentication failures
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND (service.name:"ftp" OR service.name:"sftp") AND event.outcome:"failure"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Brute Force — Slow and Low Brute Force
rules.description: Detects slow brute force attacks that evade rate-limiting by spacing attempts over extended periods
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.outcome:"failure" AND source.ip:* AND NOT event.action:"lockout"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Credential Stuffing — Known Breached Credential List Match
rules.description: Detects login attempts using credentials from known breach databases identified by correlation with threat intelligence feeds
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.outcome:"success" AND threat.indicator.type:"username" AND tags:"known-breached-credential"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Credential Stuffing — High Velocity Login Attempts Across Accounts
rules.description: Detects credential stuffing where a single source rapidly attempts logins across many different user accounts
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.outcome:"success"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Credential Stuffing — TOR Exit Node Login Attempts
rules.description: Detects authentication attempts originating from known TOR exit nodes suggesting anonymized credential stuffing
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND source.ip:("tor-exit-node" OR "known-anonymizer") AND event.outcome:failure
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Credential Stuffing — Geo-Impossible Login Velocity
rules.description: Detects successful logins from geographically impossible locations within short timeframes indicating credential reuse across stolen accounts
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.outcome:"success" AND source.geo.country_name:* AND _marker:geo_impossible
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Credential Stuffing — Automated Tool User-Agent Detection
rules.description: Detects credential stuffing tools identified by known automation user-agent strings in authentication requests
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND user_agent.original:("curl*" OR "python-requests*" OR "Selenium*" OR "HeadlessChrome*" OR "sqlmap*" OR "Hydra*" OR "medusa*" OR "ncrack*")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Credential Stuffing — Success After Multiple Failures
rules.description: Detects successful authentication after multiple failed attempts for the same user from the same source, indicating credential guessing success
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.outcome:"success" AND _marker:preceded_by_failures AND source.ip:*
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Credential Stuffing — Unusual Login Time Pattern
rules.description: Detects login patterns during unusual hours consistent with automated credential stuffing campaigns
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.outcome:"success" AND event.action:"login" AND _marker:unusual_time
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: MFA Bypass — MFA Fatigue Attack
rules.description: Detects MFA fatigue/push-bombing attacks where an attacker repeatedly triggers MFA push notifications to wear down the victim
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"mfa-challenge" AND event.outcome:"failure"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: MFA Bypass — SIM Swap Attack Detection
rules.description: Detects SIM swap attacks where an attacker transfers a victim's phone number to bypass SMS-based MFA
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"sim-change" AND user.name:*
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: MFA Bypass — MFA Token Replay
rules.description: Detects replay of captured MFA tokens by identifying the same OTP used more than once across different sessions or IPs
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"mfa-verify" AND _marker:token_replay
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: MFA Bypass — Downgrade Attack to Single-Factor Auth
rules.description: Detects authentication downgrade attacks where MFA requirement is bypassed by forcing single-factor authentication
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"login" AND event.outcome:"success" AND NOT event.action:"mfa-verify" AND user.name:* AND _marker:mfa_required_user
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: MFA Bypass — Adversary-in-the-Middle MFA Proxy
rules.description: Detects AiTM phishing proxy attacks that intercept MFA tokens in real-time by identifying session anomalies
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"mfa-verify" AND event.outcome:"success" AND _marker:aitm_proxy
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: MFA Bypass — Recovery Code Abuse
rules.description: Detects abuse of MFA recovery/backup codes to bypass normal MFA authentication flow
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"recovery-code-use" AND event.outcome:"success"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: MFA Bypass — Expired MFA Token Accepted
rules.description: Detects authentication using expired or stale MFA tokens indicating potential replay or system misconfiguration
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"mfa-verify" AND _marker:expired_token
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: MFA Bypass — MFA Registration for Another User
rules.description: Detects suspicious MFA device registration attempts for accounts the user does not own
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"mfa-register" AND NOT user.name:_marker_actor_match
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: MFA Bypass — SMS MFA Phishing via Fake Portal
rules.description: Detects phishing attacks targeting SMS-based MFA through fake authentication portals
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"sms-mfa-verify" AND url.original:*phishing* AND event.outcome:"success"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: MFA Bypass — Bypass via Legacy Protocol
rules.description: Detects authentication using legacy protocols that bypass MFA requirements such as POP3, IMAP, or legacy Exchange ActiveSync
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.outcome:"success" AND (service.name:"pop3" OR service.name:"imap" OR service.name:"activesync-legacy") AND user.name:* AND _marker:mfa_required_user
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Account Lockout — Mass Account Lockout Storm
rules.description: Detects mass account lockout events across many users indicating a credential stuffing or DoS attack forcing lockouts
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"lockout"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Account Lockout — Single Account Repeated Lockout
rules.description: Detects repeated lockout events for a single user account indicating targeted brute force or harassment
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"lockout"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Account Lockout — Lockout Followed by Unlock Anomaly
rules.description: Detects account lockout immediately followed by unlock from a different source, suggesting attacker activity
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"unlock" AND NOT source.ip:_marker_lockout_source
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Account Lockout — Admin Account Lockout
rules.description: Detects lockout of privileged or admin accounts which may indicate targeted attack against high-value accounts
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"lockout" AND user.name:("admin" OR "root" OR "administrator" OR "sudo" OR *_admin* OR *_adm*)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Account Lockout — Lockout from Impossible Location
rules.description: Detects account lockout events originating from locations inconsistent with the user's typical access patterns
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"lockout" AND _marker:geo_anomaly
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Auth Error — Invalid Username Pattern Detection
rules.description: Detects authentication failures with invalid or nonexistent usernames indicating reconnaissance or enumeration attempts
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.outcome:"failure" AND event.reason:"user-not-found" AND source.ip:*
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Auth Error — Weak Password Accepted
rules.description: Detects successful authentication with passwords that match known weak password lists
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.outcome:"success" AND _marker:weak_password
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Auth Error — Default Credential Usage
rules.description: Detects authentication using default or vendor-provided credentials indicating unpatched systems
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.outcome:"success" AND _marker:default_credential
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Auth Error — Kerberos Pre-Auth Failure
rules.description: Detects Kerberos pre-authentication failures that may indicate password guessing attacks against Active Directory
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"kerberos-preauth" AND event.outcome:"failure"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Auth Error — NTLM Relay Attack
rules.description: Detects NTLM authentication relay attacks where credentials are forwarded to unintended services
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"ntlm-auth" AND _marker:relay_detected
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Auth Error — Pass-the-Hash Detection
rules.description: Detects pass-the-hash attacks where NTLM hashes are used directly for authentication without knowing the plaintext password
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"ntlm-auth" AND event.outcome:"success" AND NOT event.action:"password-auth" AND _marker:hash_auth
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Auth Error — Golden Ticket Detection
rules.description: Detects Kerberos Golden Ticket attacks by identifying forged TGTs with unusual characteristics
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"kerberos-tgs" AND _marker:golden_ticket_anomaly
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Auth Error — Privilege Escalation via Authentication
rules.description: Detects unauthorized privilege escalation through authentication mechanisms such as sudo to root or runas administrator
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"privilege-escalation" AND event.outcome:"success" AND NOT user.name:("admin" OR "root")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Auth Error — Concurrent Session from Multiple Locations
rules.description: Detects concurrent authenticated sessions from multiple geographic locations for the same user indicating account compromise
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.outcome:"success" AND _marker:concurrent_geo_sessions
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Auth Error — Authentication Protocol Downgrade
rules.description: Detects authentication protocol downgrade attacks where stronger protocols are forced to weaker ones
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND _marker:protocol_downgrade AND event.outcome:*
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Auth Error — Token Manipulation and Forgery
rules.description: Detects forged or manipulated authentication tokens including JWT tampering and session token manipulation
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND (event.action:"token-validate" OR event.action:"jwt-validate") AND event.outcome:"failure" AND event.reason:"signature-invalid"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Auth Error — Broken Authentication Session Fixation
rules.description: Detects session fixation attacks where an attacker sets a session ID before the victim authenticates
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"session-create" AND _marker:pre_existing_session_id
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Auth Error — Excessive Failed Login from Tor/Proxy
rules.description: Detects high volume failed authentication attempts from known anonymization services
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.outcome:"failure" AND source.ip:("tor-exit-node" OR "known-proxy" OR "vpn-provider") AND source.geo.country_name:*
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Auth Error — Credential Stuffing via API Endpoint
rules.description: Detects credential stuffing attacks targeting API authentication endpoints with automated high-volume requests
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.outcome:"failure" AND url.path:("/api/auth*" OR "/api/login*" OR "/oauth/token")
author: SIEM Alert Rules
